headline: Welcome to the hand-eye coordination reaction experiment
description:
During the experiment, the speed and correctness of your hand-eye coordination will be measured. Arrow directions will be shown to you.
Your task will be to press the right button as quickly and correctly as possible .
You can use the A and L keys on the keyboard.

Please fill out the following questions as correctly as possible with reference to your hand-eye coordination.
Required fields are shown in bold letters and must be filled in.
Please focus on the fixation point during the experiment.
